text: Ichihime
Who's there?!
Sakura Matou
I'm Sakura Matou, a student at Homurahara Academy.
Saber
His name is Shirou Emiya, and we go to the same school.
No, I'm in the archery club... Why would you think I'm in the mahjong club?
Because nine out of ten people who travel here do so because of mahjong, nyaa!
Strangers?
They just went and took him away instead.
Yeah, based on what I've heard, it's definitely not on you, nyaa.
In that case, I'll help too, nyaa!
...You're willing to help us, Miss Ichihime?
First Day
One Han City - Some District
Police Station - Entrance
Nyaa! That stupid rabbit dumped all the planning stuff on me! Why's there so much annoying paperwork, nyaa...
Cut me some slack! Can't organizing a competition be as simple as eating, nyaa?
Sorry, I messed up. I didn't expect things to turn out like this...
No, Saber, you didn't do anything wrong... But what we should do now...
I wonder if there's any way to just bypass all this red tape... Nyaa?!
Ah!
Geez! Where are you looking, nyaa... Huh? Are you visitors from another city, nyaa?
Excuse me... are you a local here?
This might seem a bit random, but can I ask you something... What would you do if you encountered a kidnapping situation?
What, nyaa?! A kidnapping?!
How did it go, nyaa? Did the police confirm it's a kidnapping case?
Thank you for the reminder. I didn't think of going to the police at all.
Please call me Saber. I am... a companion of sorts to Sakura and the people around her.
Just relax, Sakura. I'll know if anything happens to Shirou.
I'm getting more confused the more I listen. What's actually going on, nyaa?
I'm sorry. I ended up having you come along to the police station without giving you a proper explanation...
Saber, my senpai, and I came to this city to do something.
I've heard that the game of mahjong is big in this city, but I never thought it would be that popular.
We were just checking out the area after we arrived, and out of nowhere, a bunch of strangers closed in on us.
Yes, we didn't know any of them. They almost managed to drag me onto their vehicle, and senpai was trying to protect me...
Speaking of which, I can't forgive those criminals! What if they scare all the tourists away from One Han City, nyaa?!
The police said they would investigate the kidnapping... Sakura, what do you have in mind?
...Although the police are helping us, I can't just sit around while senpai is in danger.
Don't you worry about it! I'm doing this for One Han City's reputation, nyaa!
...How did you know that we're outsiders?
I only said that because I don't recognize your uniform. Anyway, welcome to One Han City!
Nyaa? Well, it's true that I've lived here for a long time... Oh, you can just call me by my name – I'm Ichihime, nyaa.
Hmm, I don't know that school. You must be from a very far place, nyaa.
Um, who are you?
Well... I guess you're right. Thank you, Saber.
Who's this "senpai" you mentioned, nyaa?
Since you've come all the way to One Han City, are you members of your school's mahjong club, nyaa?
Shirou is in danger because we split up. I was too careless.
It's not your fault. I never imagined that something like this would happen...
I was in a panic at the time, and then you appeared, Miss Ichihime. Thank you for taking us to the police.
You're right. We also need to do our best to find clues ourselves.
Searching for a person in a place you don't know is like looking for a needle in a haystack. I can definitely help you since I'm a local, nyaa!
Are you sure it'll be okay...? I have no idea what will happen. It might even end up causing you more trouble...
Th-That would be great...! Thank you so much...!
